run.notes: Early run 20 Nov (Dubai ~05:40-06:30, before China market hours), so most prints are 17-19 Nov. Direct checklist URLs could not be opened (fetch permission prompts unanswered in this unattended run); pages were reached via search results instead. Found: xylene 6,800 (GuideChem 19 Nov, -200); PA 9,667 (19 Nov, verified vs Mysteel 9,600); styrene 9,810 (18 Nov); E-51 14,900 (Mysteel 19 Nov, -100); BA 9,100/9,200/9,250 (Longzhong 16-18 Nov); MMA 12,300 (Longzhong 18 Nov); BPA 10,750; ECH 10,950; butyl acetate 7,700 (ChemicalBook Jiangsu 18 Nov) and 7,450-7,650 (Mysteel 17 Nov); acetic acid 3,550; TiO2 chloride 14,000-16,800 (SMM 6 Nov). Drivers: Brent 91.95 (18 Nov), FCPO Feb 4,547 (16 Nov), Ti concentrate 1,075 avg (6 Nov). FX: USDCNY 6.7132 (17 Nov), 6.7141 (16 Nov). NOT found: HDI monomer (Mysteel curing-agent page and GuideChem 822-06-0 not reachable), soybean oil spot (10jqka pages unreadable), 2-EHA, acrylic acid, HEMA, white spirit 200#, E-20, HDI biuret, S-100#, DCE/ZCE futures closes, n-butanol, freight, today's USDCNY parity. Blocked: 100ppi.com (security check), nenghua.m.mysteel.com (robots), news.10jqka.com.cn (redirect loop / permission denied), cls.cn (binary). Data note: earlier payload shows East China BA 10,800 (m.mysteel 1602700, 18 Nov) vs Longzhong 9,100 the same day — conflicting series; today's Longzhong prints are 9,100-9,250. No forecasts (Friday).

events.title: E-51 market price slips another 100 CNY/t to 14,900
events.summary: Mysteel's E-51 market price fell 100 to 14,900 CNY/t on 19 Nov; producer offers (Dalian Qihua 15,500 ex-works) stay above market as buyers hold back.

events.title: Huangshan solid epoxy (E-12) producers cut offers by 100-500 CNY/t
events.summary: Huangshan Tianma lowered E-12 to 14,900 (-100) and Shexian Yongli to 14,800 delivered (-500) on 19 Nov; E-12 is a different grade from E-20 but signals softer solid-resin pricing.

events.title: Shandong xylene drops 200 CNY/t to 6,800
events.summary: GuideChem's East China (Shandong isomer-grade) xylene quote fell to 6,800 CNY/t on 19 Nov from 7,000, the third decline this week.

events.title: East China butyl acrylate extends decline to 9,100
events.summary: Longzhong daily reviews show East China BA down 9,250 → 9,200 → 9,100 CNY/t over 16-18 Nov on limited downstream buying.

events.title: MMA keeps sliding in East China (12,300 on 18 Nov)
events.summary: MMA日评: East China 12,600 (16 Nov) → 12,450 → 12,300 (18 Nov); demand is buying only as needed.

events.title: Brent near 2½-month low as surplus outweighs Iran/Hormuz risk
events.summary: Brent settled at $91.95 on 18 Nov and traded around $92 on 19-20 Nov (CFD); Trading Economics reports a 2½-month low as ample supply counters Middle East risk.
